title: •Padmé Naberrie
caption: •Padmé Naberrie (V)
game_text: {pilot:1}. During opponent’s control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ one Leia or non-Jedi Luke. At end of opponent’s turn, opponent loses 1 Force for each Skywalker occupying a battleground (-1 Force if Vader on table).
lore: Queen Amidala posed as one of her own handmaidens for added safety as well as to keep an eye on her Jedi protectors. Was to be protected by the Jedi at all times.

notes: Unique. Title with é as printed and as the slip prints it ('•Padmé Naberrie'); wiki pages spell it 'Padme' (the stub is 'Padme Naberrie (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm)'; the 'Padmé' spelling returns no page). NEW AFFILIATION: printed base is a Republic character (Tatooine, silver frame, Republic crest disc) → "Republic". Slip stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 4 / FORCE-SENSITIVE differ from the printed POWER 3 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED; deploy 3 / forfeit 6 (printed 2/5). Starts with the yellow LS pilot-power icon + '1.' → {pilot:1}. Slip prints ▲ (tight: 'to▲one'). Icon column: pilot, warrior (printed: warrior only). Margin credits printed vertically in two lines each: left 'Original concept' / 'by Lee Clarke', right 'CanCon' / '2005'. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 2001 (Tatooine) legible. Modern: V3-L-padmenaberrie.gif (745 px) is the PC's Virtual Set 3 Padmé Naberrie — a different later card with the same art and lore; used for art only. VB5 -pre and the _ai (Alternate Image) printings exist, not downloaded.
